card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: The middle or near-final piece of an uppercase brand name, such as RITUX-AN or UPTRAV-I, in dosing text. The name is usually split into pieces and still unfinished at this point.

modes.label: Brand name in dosing text
modes.description: A capitalized brand name is partly spelled out right before a dosing or administration statement.
modes.example: RITUX<<AN>> should only be administered by a healthcare professional

modes.label: Brand name in interaction or use text
modes.description: The same partial brand-name piece appears in interaction, warning, or use statements.

card.writes: It adds the last pieces of a brand name, such as a trademark symbol or the end of a product name.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a capitalized brand drug name, before the name is finished.
